messages:
samir: quick check — I spotted a raw bearer token in telemetry for a failed request to /v1/generate earlier. snippet below, I redacted the middle but the prefix 'sk-' is visible. is this expected? :warning:

infra-bot: Alert: proxy-telemetry captured request_body for request_id=7f9a3d path=/v1/generate status=502

maria: not expected. we should never persist Authorization headers or prompt text. can you paste the obfuscated snippet (no full secrets) so we can see exactly where it leaked? :eyes:

samir: sure — pasted obfuscated snippet below:
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer sk-1a2bREDACTEDc3d4",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  "body": {
    "prompt": "summarize: user data -> [REDACTED_LONG_TEXT]
...",
    "max_tokens": 256
  }
}
```

kevin: ugh. looks like our error-path logging (the 5xx handler) does a full dump of req.headers + req.body before the proxy strips. we scrub headers on the success path but not errors. @anya can you confirm if there's an existing scrub util?

anya: yep I'll take this. quick mitigation: add a scrubber to the global error handler so we never log raw headers/body on failure. plan: remove Authorization header, mask tokens (keep first 4 + last 4), and replace prompt/body text with a length-limited placeholder (e.g., "<REDACTED_PROMPT length=1234>"). i'll open a PR with tests.

maria: also double-check the telemetry collector (ingest) so we don't persist raw request_body fields downstream. ideally the collector should truncate or drop request bodies entirely for non-debug environments.

samir: is there already a masking util we can reuse (path or file)? i recall something in eng-infra utils like redact.ts but not sure. i can add a unit test for it.

anya: there is a small helper in infra/common/redact.ts but it's minimal. i'll extend it to support token prefix/suffix masking and prompt-length summary. opening PR now.

anya: PR: 5328 opened — branch fix/scrub-error-logs. includes: global error-handler change, updated redact util, unit tests for masking, and updated telemetry ingest config to drop request_body in prod.

kevin: i'll review PR 5328 today. also please create an incident ticket for customer-facing impact and run a quick grep across logs to see how many events contain "Authorization: Bearer" so we can assess blast radius. suggest ticket #IN-987.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for branch fix/scrub-error-logs -> staging (build 202).

maria: once PR merged, i'll update dashboards to remove request_body from slow-query dashboards and add an alert if any future telemetry includes an Authorization header.

samir: thanks everyone — i'll follow up in #incidents with grep results and link the PR. cc @kevin for review. :thumbsup:
